name: GainSnap
summary: Toggle peak matching for Ableton tracks
description: GainSnap measures an incoming track peak while Match is enabled, applies the gain needed to reach a chosen target when Match is disabled, and holds that gain until the next measurement.
features: Reproducible CLAP and VST3 release automation
